courses.title: Structured Problem Solving in Practice
courses.description: Structured Problem Solving in Practice focuses on structured problem solving for people working toward a People Manager role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces adaptability, enough to apply alongside structured problem solving in real People Manager work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to structured problem solving and show how adaptability supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying structured problem solving to a real People Manager scenario
Practicing structured problem solving through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to adaptability
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Clinical Trial Design for Practitioners
courses.description: Clinical Trial Design for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of clinical trial design, for people already working toward a People Manager role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in clinical trial design and want to go further.

Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
